lots.key_photo_findings: One photo of both sleeves. Handwriting read: '3 1/2 claw' x3, 'Centenary of Australia' with six state names, 'Bradman', '1970 James Cook', 'Anniversary Decimals', 'change-over', 'Royal Visit', 'Charles + Diana' (looks gilt-coloured or toned), 'William + Catherine', '1971 low mintage', '1997 low mintage', '1973 low mintage', '1985 1 mill only', '1995 1 mill only'. Enlarged crop of the three claw coins: dates and claw count not readable; one coin is rotated. Coins look circulated to lightly circulated, some dull.
lots.condition: Mixed circulated to near uncirculated in plastic sleeves; no grading; claw variety and 'low mintage' claims are the vendor's handwriting and unverified.
lots.question_for_gowans: Can you check the three '3 1/2 claw' 20c are dated 1981 and show the scalloped (3 1/2 claw) reverse, and roughly what grade they are?
